// name: Unscoped on purpose: vsce rejects a scoped npm name as an extension identifier.
name: sidelong-claude-status-bar
description: Companion to the Sidelong status bar for Claude Code. Sends workspace, active editor, focus and diagnostics to the overlay so notifications stay quiet while you are already looking at VS Code. It cannot observe Claude Code's state — that comes from hooks.
// keywords: The searchable surface. The product name is distinctive on purpose; the words people actually type go here and in the description, not in the name.

sidelong.port.description: Port the Sidelong desktop app listens on. Must match the app's config.

sidelong.token.markdownDescription: Optional override. By default the token is read from the desktop app's local config file, so it is never stored in VS Code settings (and never travels through Settings Sync).
